current_stage.name: D113/D114: wall-artifact investigation -- repairing Tsushima/Goto z8-11 gap
current_stage.description: Published 1-go has coastline wall artifacts. D113/D114 (delegated to Opus and Fable for independent verification) found 3 distinct causes: (A) MapLibre renders missing raster-dem tiles as a -32768m abyss rather than sea level -- confirmed a real Tsushima/Goto z8-11 gap (west of exactly 129.375E) on top of the already-known z13+ gap; (B) a structural erosion-gate bug in aggregation_merge.py (present upstream in mapterhorn/mapterhorn too) that prevents its own blur from ever running on a zero-filled coastline boundary, producing the sub-tile jagged walls seen at Nagasaki peninsula/Etajima -- not yet fixed; (C) serving hygiene (mixed RGB/RGBA tile vintages, maxzoom over-advertised in TileJSON) -- not yet addressed. Currently repairing (A) for Tsushima/Goto: confirmed the underlying pmtiles data already exists locally (old flat pmtiles-store layout, pre-D107) so no regeneration is needed -- only a bundle/merge omission from the original 1-go publish run. Rebuilding bundle-store now via a temporary git-archaeology bundle.py (pre-D107 flat-glob version, does not touch the real D107-refactored bundle.py kept for 1.5-go) in screen session bundle_rebuild on slate. Republish to stars still needs a separate go-ahead from Hidenori once verified locally.
